title: Which federal appeals court will next rule that state gambling laws apply to Kalshi’s event contracts?
background: Kalshi offers contracts tied to the outcomes of real-world events. Federal appeals courts have reached conflicting conclusions about whether these contracts are subject to state gambling laws.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Published federal appeals court decisions, corroborated by reliable news reporting. 
  Resolution Condition : Identify the first federal circuit court of appeals to issue a ruling after August 31, 2026, holding that states may apply their gambling laws to Kalshi’s event contracts. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the federal appeals circuit.
